title: 1RB0LE_0RC0RA_1RD1RF_1LA0LD_1LD0RF_1RB---: copy rounds are left-end ticks, as Lean rules for every front
text: Each round of a copy tick runs the same middle as the left-end tick of the list F|3, with F the front at that round. For any front, Lean turns a proved middle into both the tick and the copy round. Even blocks after a separator 1 are passed through unchanged, however many there are, and the turn is proved for 22 shapes with any block sizes. So 2,013 of the 2,094 copy rounds of the first 10<sup>10</sup> steps follow from rules for every front of their shape. The rest are mostly the first round or two of a tick.
